comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Edwards is a branded OEM selling its own heart valves to hospitals, not a contract manufacturer for device makers.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Contract cosmetics manufacturer; similar model but a different industry with no medical device or regulatory overlap.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Merit mainly sells its own branded disposable devices to hospitals; OEM supply is a minor part, unlike a pure CDMO.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: General on-demand prototype and low-volume parts across many industries; medical is just one end market, with no device CDMO focus.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Sterilization and lab testing services, not manufacturing of devices or components, though it serves the same device OEM customers.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Contract manufacturer of medical device components and single-use devices for device OEMs, with design and development services and FDA/ISO 13485 compliance.
